name: Werewolf

armorClass.type: natural armor (wolf form) or no armor

damageImmunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger.
traits.text: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, not including AC, are the same in each form. Equipment isn't transformed. Reverts to humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell.
traits.text: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: In humanoid form: two attacks (one bite, one shortsword). In wolf/hybrid form: two bites.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Humanoid target must succeed DC 12 CON or contract werewolf lycanthropy.
